content: Green Room canonical file as of this session is /mnt/user-data/outputs/green-room-session-concierge.html (replaces the earlier probe). Engine and 29-cultivar library unchanged from the original Green Room probe. What was added: (1) a session archetype label per intention (Unwind/Gather/Connect/Deep Talk/Create/Lock In/Clear/Move/Body Calm/Toward Sleep); (2) an atmosphere panel that renders per-intention lighting, air/temperature, and a named 3-color palette as live swatches, with the page background washing to that palette on result via CSS color-mix; (3) a Sound row above Watch/Taste/Do with an optional white-label playlist hook (off by default for full offline); (4) a structured Landing block with an essence line, ordered ritual steps keyed to the ending mode (soft/sleep/stay), and the original goal-specific land line woven in as the closing beat; (5) a separate closing timer that appears only when ending=='sleep'; (6) a saved-sessions library at step s9 backed by localStorage with an in-memory fallback shim, supporting open/share-as-plain-text/delete; (7) a CONFIG block at the top of the script for white-label use (name, tagline, label line, playlist base URL, storage key, max saved); (8) prefers-reduced-motion guard and visible focus states. Path the work took: built first as a separate 'ritual-os.html' that extended Green Room in place, then on Anthony's instruction folded back into Green Room itself with all Ritual OS naming removed and zero leakage verified. Retrieve when Anthony references Green Room's current capabilities, the white-label CONFIG, or considers further expansion.
